Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] }} '''Ord Radama''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Radama Void/Legends|Radama Void]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]]. Once a world of marshes and wetlands, it was built up with [[City/Legends|cities]] and streets over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. The planet was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Devlikk/Legends|Devlikk]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. ==History== [[File:Ord_Radama_orbit.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Battle of Ord Radama]].]] Ord Radama was once an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Ord Radama was conquered by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], Ord Radama aligned with the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]], the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reformed Sith Empire]] [[Battle of Ord Radama|attacked]] Ord Radama, under the command of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]]. Initially successful, Malgus' forces laid siege to [[Livien Magnus]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Ord Radama, and after a week the city fell to them. However, the Sith forces were not subsequently resupplied and a few weeks later, the Republic sent a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to Ord Radama, to drive the Sith from the planet. The Republic ships decimated Malgus' fleet and during the engagement, a stricken Sith [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] plummeted into the atmosphere of Ord Radama and crashed into Livien Magnus, destroying the city and [[Death/Legends|killing]] one hundred thousand of the world's inhabitants. The Sith subsequently abandoned Ord Radama and the city [[New Raido]] became the planet's new capital. However, in the aftermath of the attack, the Ord Radama natives struggled to survive, while the Republic did little to fortify the world. Several months later, the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], the ruler of the Sith Empire, ordered Malgus to retake Ord Radama, and Malgus launched a [[Reconquest of Ord Radama|fresh attack]] on the world. The invasion did not go smoothly and Malgus' forces were confounded by the forces of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], but Malgus remained confident that he would be victorious. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ord Radama was a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] stronghold [[Battle of Ord Radama (Clone Wars)|tackled]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during the [[Serenno theater]] of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. ===Galactic Empire===
[[File:RiallaWayLivienMagnus-OAAI.png|thumb|right|220px|Stormtroopers patrolling Livien Magnus]]
Ord Radama was quickly brought under the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to serve as a staging post in pacifying the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The people of Ord Radama initially welcomed the strength and stability the Empire offered, though this relative peace was provided through the systematic oppression of any dissidents or rebels. [[Ellor Orgraal]] eventually became the [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of Ord Radama and solidified his power by crushing anyone who spoke out against the Empire or himself. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Xantus]] commanded the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] garrisoned on the planet and reported directly to Governor Orgraal, who believed he had the final say in all matters on his world. However, General Xantus actually took his orders from the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence Service]], the true power behind the military on the world. Under the Empire, the native [[Devlikk/Legends|Devlikks]] were forced into servitude and, in many instances, outright [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. Relocated in the poorest areas of the planet to make way for Imperial housing, they lived in makeshift homes and horrible conditions. Many worked in the industrial sector or as servants for the local [[Noble/Legends|nobles]]. The Devlikks came to harbor a deep hatred of the Empire and began to form a small resistance movement under the leadership of [[Narralla]]. These rebels started to quietly gather intel for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]], using their positions as servants to their advantage. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the planet had a strong military presence and was protected by infrequent patrols of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] and the [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Eternal Wrath]]''. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a small band of Rebels [[Mission to Ord Radama|came to]] Ord Radama in order to rescue [[Senior Advisor/Legends|Senior Advisor]] [[Setenna Hase]], a valuable Alliance leader who was [[Kidnapping of Setenna Hase|kidnapped]] by [[Var Narek]], a traitor and an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]] operating for [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Malau Jocaos]] of the Imperial
